categories.main_business_segments: LB Group primarily operates in the titanium industry, focusing on titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment production, sponge titanium manufacturing, zirconium products, and lithium battery cathode and anode materials. The company integrates upstream mining of titanium ores with midstream chemical processing and downstream product manufacturing, including both sulfate and chloride processes for titanium dioxide. It also has significant operations in new energy materials, including lithium iron phosphate and graphite anode materials for lithium-ion batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced sulfate and chloride methods for titanium dioxide production, including large-scale continuous production and proprietary technologies such as fluidized bed chlorination and sulfur-chlorine coupling green manufacturing. It also uses melting salt chlorination and reduction-distillation for sponge titanium production. In lithium battery materials, it utilizes solid-phase and liquid-phase synthesis for cathode materials and advanced graphitization processes for anode materials. The company emphasizes green and low-cost production with integrated recycling of by-products like ferrous sulfate.
categories.primary_customers_markets: LB Group serves a diverse customer base across coatings, plastics, paper, printing inks, rubber, aerospace, biomedical, chemical metallurgy, marine engineering, and new energy sectors. Its titanium dioxide products are widely used in coatings and plastics industries globally. The lithium battery materials target electric vehicle manufacturers and energy storage sectors. The company exports to over 100 countries and regions across six continents, with significant sales in Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Henan, Sichuan, Hubei, Yunnan, and Gansu provinces. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in Hong Kong, Europe, and the Americas to support its international market expansion. Its products are sold worldwide, covering more than 100 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: LB Group operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream mining of titanium ores, midstream processing into titanium concentrates and intermediates, and downstream manufacturing of titanium dioxide pigments, sponge titanium, and lithium battery materials. It controls key raw material resources and processes, positioning itself as a full-chain operator from raw material extraction to finished product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in advanced titanium dioxide production technologies, including large-scale fluidized bed chlorination and green sulfur-chlorine coupling processes. It focuses on developing high-end titanium dioxide products with enhanced brightness, coverage, and weather resistance. In new energy materials, it advances lithium iron phosphate and graphite anode technologies for improved battery performance. LB Group also emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and green sustainable development through waste recycling and energy efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: LB Group generates revenue primarily through the sale of titanium dioxide pigments, sponge titanium, zirconium products, and lithium battery materials. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance, including export sales confirmed through customs clearance and shipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: LB Group is a global leader in the titanium industry, ranking as the world's largest producer of titanium dioxide by capacity and a top producer of sponge titanium. It is among the few companies worldwide with both sulfate and chloride titanium dioxide production capabilities. The company holds a leading position in China and competes internationally with major chemical and materials companies in titanium and new energy sectors. Its brand 'Xuelian' is recognized globally for quality and influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, LB Group achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 26.76 billion, an 11% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.23 billion, a slight decline of 5.64%. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 63.8 billion and net assets of RMB 22.48 billion, reflecting steady growth and expansion. It maintains a strong cash flow from operations and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technological upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LB Group emphasizes its full industry chain integration, advanced proprietary technologies, and green manufacturing processes to deliver high-quality, cost-effective titanium dioxide and titanium products. Its unique sulfur-chlorine coupling green economy model enables efficient resource recycling and cost reduction. The company offers a broad product portfolio with superior brightness, coverage, and durability, supported by strong technical service and customer support. Its strategic coupling of titanium and lithium battery materials leverages by-product utilization to lower costs and enhance sustainability.
